answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Every claim climbs the hollow of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the tundra re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Reaching the zenith of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, clawed back after a replayed submission, the unit of trust is a task, not an address.
